script_text: Stop — that repeating number you keep seeing isn't a coincidence. But heed the shadow — Chiron squares this transit from Aries, reopening old scarcity wounds that tempt you to chase digits instead of trusting them. Your North Node demands surrender: repetition is guidance, never permission to gamble. Journal every sequence for seven days and carry your number written down. Comment the number that keeps haunting you below — the cosmos already knows why.
